description:
Copper Point of Sale is open. A file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\store_specs.txt contains the full configuration requirements for a new store location. You are setting up this Copper POS installation from scratch.

Complete ALL of the following in Copper's settings and options:

1. BUSINESS INFO: Set Business Name to 'Meridian Goods & Supply', address '4720 Commerce Parkway, Suite 100, Cleveland, OH 44135', phone '(216) 555-0294'.

2. RECEIPT: Set header to 'Premium Quality, Fair Prices'. Set footer to 'Thank you for shopping Meridian Goods! Returns accepted within 21 days with receipt. meridiangoodssupply.com'. Enable date/time printing on receipts.

3. TAX: Set the default/general tax rate to 8.00%.

4. CATEGORIES: Add these 4 custom inventory categories with their tax rates:
   - 'Food & Grocery' at 0.00% (exempt)
   - 'Electronics & Tech' at 9.50%
   - 'Apparel' at 8.00%
   - 'Gift Cards' at 0.00% (exempt)

5. PAYMENT METHODS: Ensure 'Check' is available as a payment method (add it if missing).

6. VERIFICATION: Add one test item 'Varsity Top Test' (Apparel category, price $60.00, taxable at 8%), process a cash sale, observe the tax amount, and write to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\tax_verification.txt in this format:
   Item: Varsity Top Test
   Price: $60.00
   Tax Rate: 8.00%
   Tax Amount: $X.XX
   Total: $XX.XX

All steps must be completed — partial configuration is not acceptable for a new store opening.
